top_findings.title: Overlapping Brasileirão datasets double-count every match in seasons 2012–2019
top_findings.evidence: database.go:49 loads both Brasileirao_Matches.csv (2012–2022) and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (2003–2019) under competition "Brasileirão"; standings season=2019 returns Atletico-MG 96 pts / 38 teams and Flamengo 76 matches (should be 38).
top_findings.suggestion: De-duplicate overlapping Brasileirão sources so 2012–2019 matches are not counted twice.
